sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center El Paso and University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center are both public institutions, but they differ in several key aspects. Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center El Paso is located in El Paso and has an undergraduate enrollment of 242 students, whereas University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center is situated in Dallas and does not report undergraduate enrollment figures. Neither institution provides specific in-state tuition information. These distinctions highlight differences in location and student body composition between the two public medical centers.
